[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Stream Data Centers was founded in 1999. This session sourced and dated the companys recent ownership change, previously recorded without a citation: per Apollo Global Managements own press releases, Apollo announced a deal to acquire a majority stake in Stream Data Centers in August 2025 and completed that acquisition on November 3, 2025, with Principal Asset Management separately acquiring a minority stake through a Principal managed fund, and Streams own management team retaining a minority stake while continuing to lead operations. The companys own site and Apollos press materials describe more than 20 to 27 campuses delivered, a 4 plus gigawatt active development pipeline, and more than 90 percent of capacity leased to Fortune 100 customers. Primary named markets include Atlanta, Chicago, Dallas-Fort Worth, Minneapolis, Phoenix, and San Antonio. This specific row, Stream Chicago II in Elk Grove Village, IL, per the operators own dedicated page for this facility, fetched fresh this session, sits at 1925 Busse Road, Elk Grove Village, Illinois 60007, internally coded ORDB and described as fully leased. That same page also lists ORDA (Chicago I, 2080 Lunt Avenue, this registrys separate Stream Chicago I row) and ORDC (Chicago III, 2000 Landmeier Rd, in development, not tracked as a row in this registry).
